settings.title:
Surfaces for calm,
considered interiors.
settings.description: Every surface is selected for its tactile quality, tonal depth and architecture presence. From calm residences to contemporary commercial spaces, Ellora Living focuses on materials that age beautifully and create spaces with emotional resonance.

settings.title: Calm atmosphere
settings.description: Surfaces crafted to instill tranquility, emotional resonance, and architectural balance in contemporary living spaces.

settings.title: Clear sizing
settings.description: Precise dimensional specifications and calculated layout increments to support seamless contractor execution.

settings.title: Honest selling unit
settings.description: Transparent square-meter and crate pricing with no hidden wastage markups or ambiguous selling minimums.

settings.title: Guided selection
settings.description: Dedicated stone consultants and architectural specialists ready to support your layout drawings and technical needs.

settings.title: Tiles
settings.description: Stone textures, patterned and large format tile options for verandhs, yoga rooms, meditation areas and calm residential interiors.

settings.title: Wallpaper
settings.description: Soft repetitive papers, decorative panels and large scale whole wall murals designed to complete through multiple matching panels.

settings.title: Explore by Space
settings.description: Stone, porcelain and ceramic surfaces designed for wellness-oriented interiors and contemporary living.

settings.title: Single Pieces
settings.description: For standard tiles or wallpaper panels where customers can order the exact quantity they need.

settings.title: Pattern Sets
settings.description: For paired wallpaper designs that need a minimum set, such as 4 or 8 pieces, so the pattern works correctly.

settings.title: Mural Panel Sets
settings.description: For multi-wallpapers sold as complete mural sets. These cannot be purchased individually when the artwork depends on the full set.

settings.heading:
Simple product rules
before purchase.
settings.body: Ellora should clearly show whether a product is sold by single piece, minimum pattern set, or as a full set. This avoids confusion for large tiles and multi-panel wallpapers.
